papers.title: Unfolding the applicability of 3D-printed Ti-6Al-4V alloy and platinum-based film deposition for dental prostheses applications

llm.relevance_to_user: 论文涉及增材制造Ti-6Al-4V合金及表面镀膜在牙科修复中的应用，可能包含力学性能数据，但对基体力学与疲劳特性的直接贡献有限。
llm.why_not_core: No systematic mechanical or fatigue characterization of as-built Ti-6Al-4V; emphasis on coating and dental application.

summary_zh.motivation: 探索增材制造Ti-6Al-4V合金及铂薄膜沉积在牙科修复中的适用性
summary_zh.method: 通过3D打印制备Ti-6Al-4V并进行铂薄膜沉积处理
summary_zh.result: 评估了该组合在牙科修复中的性能和适用性
summary_zh.validation: 实验表征包括力学测试和薄膜性能评估

summary_en.motivation: This study explores the applicability of additively manufactured Ti-6Al-4V alloy combined with platinum-based film deposition for dental prostheses.
summary_en.method: Ti-6Al-4V samples were fabricated via 3D printing and subsequently coated with a platinum-based film.
summary_en.result: The performance and suitability of the combined system for dental prostheses were evaluated.
summary_en.validation: Experimental characterization included mechanical testing and film property assessment.

papers.title: Evolution of powder-entrapped pores in Ti–6Al–4V fabricated with powder bed fusion-laser beam process
papers.abstract: X-ray micro computed tomography (X- μ CT) of bulk powder bed fusion - laser beam (PBF-LB) Ti-6Al-4V samples shows that, within the optimal process window – where lack-of-fusion and keyhole porosity are minimized – higher laser power reduces the number density of powder-entrapped pores when hatch spacing, layer thickness, and laser spot size remain fixed. To gain insight into this observation, the X- μ CT measurements of powder-entrapped pores are combined with a computational model to simulate pore trajectories in the PBF-LB melt pool. More than 100,000 independent pore trajectories are simulated at two different combinations of laser power and scanning velocity, where the forces acting on the pores are quantified using melt pool temperatures, pressures, and fluid flow velocities from multi-physics simulations. The model is then used to predict the pore size distributions in bulk samples fabricated within the optimal process window at 150 W, 700 mm/s and 370 W, 1200 mm/s. At both laser power settings, the total number density of pores predicted by the model is within one order of magnitude of the experimental values. The model suggests that the differences in the pore size distributions measured with X- μ CT are caused by differences in melt pool overlap (i.e., remelting). Using the model, a process map is constructed to predict porosity as a function of hatch spacing and layer thickness, suggesting that the number density of powder-entrapped pores can vary by two orders of magnitude within the optimal process window. This result suggests that the elimination of powder-entrapped pores poses an obstacle to increasing build rates by increasing the hatch spacing and layer thickness. While previous investigations of pore evolution during PBF-LB focused on experimental approaches, this work will enable the development of model-driven processing strategies to promote pore elimination.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了激光粉末床熔融Ti-6Al-4V中粉末捕获孔隙的演化机制，对理解工艺-缺陷关系有直接帮助。
llm.why_not_core: The paper focuses on pore evolution mechanisms and process maps without providing direct mechanical or fatigue data.

summary_zh.motivation: 揭示激光粉末床熔融Ti-6Al-4V中粉末捕获孔隙的演化机制
summary_zh.method: 结合X射线微CT实验和熔池多物理场模拟，追踪单个孔隙在熔池中的运动
summary_zh.result: 发现熔池重叠（重熔）是影响孔隙尺寸分布的关键因素，构建了孔隙率工艺图
summary_zh.validation: 模拟预测的孔隙数量密度与X射线CT测量值在同一个数量级内

summary_en.motivation: To elucidate the evolution mechanisms of powder-entrapped pores in PBF-LB Ti-6Al-4V within the optimal process window.
summary_en.method: Combining X-ray micro-CT measurements with multi-physics simulations of melt pool to simulate trajectories of over 100,000 individual pores.
summary_en.result: Melt pool overlap (remelting) is identified as the key factor affecting pore size distribution, and a process map predicting porosity as a function of hatch spacing and layer thickness is constructed.
summary_en.validation: The predicted pore number density from the model agrees with experimental X-ray CT values within one order of magnitude.

papers.title: Effect of Cu/Nb dual interlayers on the microstructure and mechanical properties of hot-rolled Ti-6Al-4V/EH690 steel electron beam welded clad plate
papers.first_author_affiliation: State Key Laboratory of Digital Steel, Northeastern University, Shenyang, 110819, China

corresponding_authors.name: Guangjun Xie
corresponding_authors.affiliation: State Key Laboratory of Digital Steel, Northeastern University, Shenyang, 110819, China

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文涉及Ti-6Al-4V，但研究的是电子束焊接复合板，而非增材制造，与L1方向完全无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper studies electron beam welding of Ti-6Al-4V to steel with Cu/Nb interlayers, not additive manufacturing (LPBF/SLM/EBM/DED) of Ti-6Al-4V.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究Cu/Nb双中间层对Ti-6Al-4V与EH690钢电子束焊接复合板的影响
summary_zh.method: 采用电子束焊接和热轧工艺制备复合板，进行显微组织和力学性能表征
summary_zh.result: Cu/Nb中间层改善了界面结合，提高了复合板的力学性能
summary_zh.validation: 通过拉伸、弯曲等力学测试验证

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the effect of Cu/Nb dual interlayers on the interfacial microstructure and mechanical properties of Ti-6Al-4V/EH690 steel clad plates produced by electron beam welding.
summary_en.method: Hot-rolled clad plates were fabricated using electron beam welding with Cu/Nb interlayers, followed by microstructural analysis and mechanical testing.
summary_en.result: The Cu/Nb interlayers improved interfacial bonding and enhanced the mechanical performance of the clad plate.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical tests including tensile and bending tests were conducted to validate the results.
